summary: Shattuck Labs, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 10,879,376 common shares at $4.00 per share (a 6.3% discount to the $4.27 June 9 close) and pre-funded warrants for 7,870,624 shares. The offering is an at-the-market shelf takedown, not a special situation. There is no activist, M&A, or restructuring event; it is an ordinary equity capital raise with a 30-day underwriter option.
